scope: Wall timing for serial sequences of captured attention calls only. All heads remain computed. Remote-output exactness compares remote split with the same local split shape. Full-shape comparison is separate. A local-split win is not a win over the stronger full-head kernel. Use LocalFull as primary isolated baseline. CI uses independent benchmark processes,not iteration samples or independent server starts. P/D engine queues,full36 model outputs,task quality and decode protection are not tested by this PoC. No claim of exclusive GPU compute,DMA duration,NIXL/NCCL cost or online serving speedup.
